alias: [TEST] AirCon - BedroomS - room sensor comfort band
description: Test automation for BedroomS climate.v537_spalniam_2. Uses BedroomS room temperature sensor while its battery is above the configurable room-sensor battery helper; falls back to climate current_temperature below that. Climate mode is based on configurable outside thresholds and an outside temperature fallback chain: Venti In 7 minus the configurable offset, then weather.forecast_home temperature, then sensor.venti_outside_temperature. Dynamic setpoint = climate_sensor_temperature - (effective_room_temperature - target). The main comfort target, start delta, hot-summer target, outdoor thresholds, winter target, fan mode, coil cool-down minutes, learned overshoot, Venti offset, and sensor battery thresholds are all exposed through BedroomS tuning input_number helpers. Mild summer is tuned as a configurable comfort band: cooling starts above target + start delta and moves to fan_only at target + learned overshoot. The learned overshoot is updated from each cool-down cycle using 70/30 smoothing. Night sleep window (00:30-08:30) and the 03:00-06:00 air-clean fan_only window are DISABLED during warm season (calendar March-November inclusive) as of 2026-07-24: room hit 24.5C at ~4am because the air-clean window forced fan_only and the sleep window's relaxed night_summer_target (30C) blocked real cooling exactly when the room needed it. User confirmed this room should actively cool whenever hot (evenings from ~19:30 onward through the night) for the whole Mar-Nov season, no calendar-based cooling blackout. Outside that window (Dec-Feb) the original night sleep / air-clean behavior still applies unchanged, since only the warm-season case was reported as broken. Separately, target-tier selection: `night_summer_target` (23.5C) was declared but never wired into the `target` formula, so summer always used day_summer_target (mild/hot) regardless of time. Fixed 2026-07-24: added a `summer_night_window` (19:30-08:30, BedroomS only) so summer now has 3 real tiers: mild day (24.7C, outside < mild_outside_threshold), hot day (24.5C), night (23.5C, 19:30-08:30) - night is stronger than both day targets, not a relaxed/weak mode, so this does not reintroduce the Mar-Nov blackout above. Fixed 2026-07-25: climate_mode used to be computed from the outside-proxy temperature (Venti In 7 minus offset, thresholds at 8C/15C), which caused a real incident overnight 2026-07-24/25 - the venti/ERV intake sensor naturally cools overnight (a normal diurnal swing, not real weather), pushed the adjusted outside value below the 15C summer threshold for hours, and flipped climate_mode to neutral. In neutral, every action branch (all require climate_mode == summer or winter) is a no-op, so the automation silently stopped controlling the climate entity while the room kept heating - BedroomS hit 24C with no response for over an hour before manual intervention. User confirmed the intended design: climate_mode must be determined ONLY by calendar month (Dec/Jan/Feb = winter, Mar-Nov = summer), never by any temperature reading. Rewired accordingly; the outside variable is still computed and still used for other purposes (mild/hot day-target selection, room/AC disagreement check) but no longer feeds climate_mode. During daytime, no BedroomS motion for 15m raises fan to 5 only while the climate is already in fan_only; motion restores fan 3 in fan_only. Uses climate.set_hvac_mode: off because this climate entity uses climate.set_hvac_mode: off instead of climate.turn_off, matching the other rooms' comfort-band automations. RETURN BOOST: while input_boolean.bedrooms_was_away was on and away_now becomes false (motion resumes or someone comes home), input_datetime.bedrooms_away_ended_at is stamped with now(). For input_number.bedrooms_return_boost_minutes minutes after that timestamp, cooling_fan_mode is forced to input_number.bedrooms_return_boost_fan_mode instead of the normal input_number.bedrooms_cooling_fan_mode, so air actually circulates fast enough to pull the real room down to target quickly after an away period, instead of slowly chasing a compensated setpoint at low fan speed. Intent: the away-relax band exists to save energy while empty, not to make the return transition slow - the boost undoes that trade the moment someone is back.
